setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bird Song** (4 reviews): First-set Bird Song singled out as great; Bird Song named as a standout, alongside Feel Like A Stranger [12][14][15][23]
- **Feel Like A Stranger** (4 reviews): Reviewer says the band gets lost and the Stranger is dull and tiring; First-set closer Stranger has Garcia playing ferociously; reviewer ranks it among the best and most unusual [15][16][19][22]
- **Morning Dew** (3 reviews): Dew was powerful in the room, less so on tape; Garcia's playing still comes through; Reviewer loves Garcia's scratchy, almost crying vocals on this Dew, a favorite version [14][18][19]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer hears Jack Straw as rushed [15]
- **Estimated Prophet** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Estimated jam loose and sloppy [13]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 other source): A tape flip occurs near the end of Eyes Of The World [5]
- **Truckin'** (1 review): The drums, jam and Truckin' sequence in the second set is praised as worth the download [12]

## Setlist highlights

- **Jerry Garcia Interview (By David Gans)**: back after 431 archived shows (2313 days); rare: 4 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-02.149861.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-03-02.150140.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [2]
- **gd1987-03-02.149862.ultra.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [4]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.82728.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [5]
- **gd87-03-02.sbd.lai.1965.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 141 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [6]. Said about its sound: Called a very nice soundboard recording by an unidentified taper; Recording quality is considered the show's only redeeming feature [12][13]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd-mtx.walker-scotton.miller.82729.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 19 songs; 147 min; rated 3.33/5 by 9 [7]. Said about its sound: Reviewer found Bobby's guitar or vocals too loud after Althea; Recording called excellent [22][23]

## Around the show

- Attendee says Garcia rocked back and forth while playing, and the show was loose but magical [14]
- Reviewer's recollection concerns the Kaiser as a family venue, visited at the final 1989 shows there [17]
- David Gans interviewed Jerry Garcia at the band's backstage bar [1]
- Garcia interview by David Gans was done at the band's backstage bar [2]
- Says California shows later in 1987 were tighter and more memorable than this one [13]
- Reviewer saw 36 California shows in 1987 and ranks this among favorites [16]
- Reviewer saw eight Kaiser shows and considers it the best indoor place to see the band [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-02.149861.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]. Also: Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; several sets of masters combined to complete the show [1]
- **gd1987-03-02.150140.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]
- **gd1987-03-02.149862.ultra.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [4]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.82728.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) [5]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker [5]
- **gd87-03-02.sbd.lai.1965.sbefail.shnf**: source: Soundboard [6]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd-mtx.walker-scotton.miller.82729.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) [7]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center - March 2, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/march-2-1987) [26]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Henry J. Kaiser Convention Center - March 3, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/march-3-1987) [27]
